message.content: {"evidence":"Hypothesis P1 (J1–J2) removes the sharp N/E discontinuities at J1 and J2 but leaves a residual step at J2 in U; Hypothesis P3 (J1–J4) eliminates the J1 jump and restores smooth trend through J2 and J4 in all components; Hypothesis P6 (J2–J4) fails to remove the J1 discontinuity and introduces a mismatch at J2 in N and E, confirming P3 is the only pair that removes both boundaries without creating new artifacts.","pair_ids":["P3"]}
